name: Hard Wax Beans  | Painless Hair Removal Wax Beads for Body & Facial Hair | Random flavour | 100g
description:
Achieve smooth and effective hair removal with Beans Hard Wax, a professional stripless film wax designed for convenient body waxing. The wax is applied directly to the skin using a spatula, allowed to cool and form a flexible film, and then removed without the need for traditional wax strips. Formulated with Colophonium (Rosin), Glyceryl Rosinate, Beeswax, Paraffin, Hydrogenated Coconut Oil, and other wax-conditioning ingredients, this hard wax is suitable for professional waxing applications on areas such as the legs, underarms, chest, and back.

Key Features
Professional stripless hard wax for hair removal
No wax strips required
Designed for film wax application using a spatula
Helps remove unwanted hair from the root
Suitable for professional waxing applications
Suitable for legs, underarms, chest and back
Contains Beeswax and Hydrogenated Coconut Oil
Smooth application when properly heated
Forms a removable film after cooling
Designed for convenient peel-off hair removal
Suitable for salon and professional beauty use

Product Specifications
Product Type: Hard Wax / Film Wax
Wax Type: Stripless Hard Wax
Application: Professional Hair Removal
Application Method: Spatula
Suitable Areas: Legs, Underarms, Chest & Back
Usage: Professional Use

How to Use
Place the required amount of block wax into a suitable wax heater
Heat the wax to the recommended working temperature
Test the wax temperature before applying it to the skin
Using a spatula, spread an even layer of film wax over the desired area
Apply the wax in the direction of hair growth
Allow the wax a short period to cool and form a removable film
Hold the skin taut
Remove the wax firmly against the direction of hair growth
Clean the treated area after waxing

Designed for use with a spatula
Suitable for larger body areas such as legs, chest and back

Warnings & Safety Information
For professional use only
Ensure the wax is not too hot before applying to skin
Perform a patch test on a small area before first use
Wait 24 hours after the patch test; proceed only if there is no adverse reaction
Do not use on broken, irritated or damaged skin
Do not use if you have previously experienced an adverse reaction to waxing products
If you take medication that affects the skin or have a skin-related condition, consult your doctor before use
Do not use within 2 hours after showering, bathing or sunbathing
After waxing, wait at least 24 hours before using antiperspirant, aftershave or astringent lotion on the treated area
Always test the wax temperature before application to prevent skin injury
Keep out of reach of children
